legal_ref: Value Added Tax Act No. 35 of 2013 s.5(2)(b)
quote: "(2) The rate of tax shall be— (a) in the case of a zero-rated supply, zero per cent; or (b) in any other case, sixteen per cent of the taxable value of the taxable supply..." (s.5(2)); "[Date of commencement: 2nd September, 2013.]"
source_title: Value Added Tax Act No. 35 of 2013 (revised text, KRA); KRA 'Value Added Tax' page (kra.go.ke)
notes: Two rates: 16% general and 0% zero-rate (Second Schedule); exempt supplies in First Schedule. KRA: '8% (Other rate) – This rate applied to certain supplies (petroleum products) prior to 1st July 2023 but was deleted by the Finance Act, 2023.' Registration threshold: taxable supplies of KES 5 million or more in 12 months; non-resident digital-service suppliers must register regardless of turnover. 16% also applied under the predecessor VAT Act (Cap 476); valid_from given is commencement of the 2013 Act.
unverified: Date 16% was first introduced under the repealed Cap 476 not checked; valid_from uses the 2013 Act commencement date
